final: WITH cs_c AS (SELECT c.country AS country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS ov FROM cs_c), kept AS (SELECT country, avg_wins, avg_wins - (SELECT ov FROM overall) AS excess FROM cs_c WHERE avg_wins > (SELECT ov FROM overall)), latter AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS lt FROM kept), retained AS (SELECT k.country, k.avg_wins, k.excess, k.avg_wins - l.lt AS diff FROM kept k, latter l WHERE k.avg_wins > l.lt) SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS retained_avg_wins, AVG(excess) AS retained_avg_excess, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff_vs_latter FROM retained
